feature_contract.goal: Preserve complete Quest3 main-menu and Ferrari vehicle-selector imagery across 4:3 title/menu optical correction and 16:9/21:9 source capture without erasing right-side authored pixels after a state transition.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 x64 OpenXR LOCAL-fixed main/front-end menu source-UV policy and selector optical aspect only; gameplay stereo, original screen HUD, menu input, F11, GOAL, +TIME, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DXVK and the native game's source content remain unchanged.
trace_stages: User HMD A/B 2026-10-15 proved manual 4:3 crop removes Ferrari preview/selector-right list while crop-off shows the complete original content.
vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp computed cropCentered43 before consulting clientGameState, allowing a previous title-only 4:3 A/B override to crop car-selection, select-exit/reset and unknown states.

vrhost/src/runtime/menu_content_aspect.hpp now restricts source cropping to explicit title/menu state and preserves complete native ratio for selector states even if future positive matte evidence applies; both eye clips use same rect.
subcomponents: Bound title/menu center crop to source game state; selector/exit/reset and unknown stay fully uncropped regardless of legacy crop override.
Keep native wide selector aspect and all source UV pixels including Ferrari model/options, while title/manual 4:3 and native desktop fallback remain separately valid.
Add compiled positive/negative state-transition and 16:9/21:9 selector optical regression cases without weakening existing source/CI gates.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Title/menu to full-width vehicle selector and exit/reset
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Any title-only 4:3 crop override cannot erase source UV pixels for selector/exit/reset and unknown transitions; native 16:9 and 21:9 selector aspect is retained across scene changes.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original authored title/menu and rollback / desktop
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Explicit title/menu 4:3 A/B remains available; no evidence defaults to full UV, no-crop opt-out stays authoritative, non-menu states and original game/DX9Ex fallback remain unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact SHA host/game/package and isolated feature regressions
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: C++ menu smoke and mandatory DX9Ex Active R84 x86/x64/package, Domain, relevant Inspector/Full Source gates PASS on one validation-bearing exact SHA; Quest3 optics remain independently UNTESTED.

diagnosis.root_cause: Host 4:3 manual crop was selected before client game-state checking, so forcing crop on the title can still cut full-width Ferrari selector model/list after the transition. Only optical source state should authorize this content-destructive path.
alternatives_rejected: No global crop removal or forced 4:3 aspect compression of every scene; preserve title A/B and intentionally wide selector panels.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: Source/UI state branch has deterministic test evidence. Full Quest3 HMD optics on new exact build have not been observed.

runtime_validation_notes: No Quest3/VDXR physical runtime test executed.
